records.title: Enhancing spiking transformers with temporal feedback coding and global-local dynamic neurons.
records.reason: The spiking Transformer method is evaluated on vision datasets and reports task accuracy; it is not an LLM inference/serving study.

records.title: Backspin: A backdoor attack framework for split learning based on smashed data.
records.reason: Backspin is a backdoor attack against split learning across CV/NLP tasks; the contribution is security attack efficacy, not inference efficiency.

records.title: VLM-Guided Key Information Extraction for Chinese Visually-Rich Documents
records.reason: The work applies a VLM to key-information extraction from visually rich Chinese documents; the packet title/abstract do not present an inference-efficiency or serving method.

records.title: A comprehensive survey on multi-GPU systems
records.reason: The ScienceDirect primary article endpoint returned HTTP 403; the indexed primary abstract/introduction describe a broad multi-GPU survey, but detailed reviewed methods, boundaries and treatment of LLM inference could not be checked.

records.title: LSBR-pkd: A lightweight model for student behavior recognition via co-optimization of pruning and knowledge distillation
records.reason: LSBR-pkd is a student-behavior recognition model using pruning/distillation for a vision task, not LLM inference/serving.
